findings.summary: The 1.4s rise entrance (an 80px translate plus a scale) on the h1 and p has no prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
findings.fix: Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that removes the translate and scale, leaving at most a short opacity fade.

findings.summary: The looping background video autoplays with no pause control and ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
findings.fix: Don't autoplay when reduced motion is requested (show a poster frame instead), and add a visible pause control.

findings.summary: The parallax scroll listener writes a transform on every scroll event, with no rAF throttling and no passive flag.
findings.fix: Register the listener as passive, batch the transform write in requestAnimationFrame, or use a CSS scroll-driven animation.

findings.summary: The scroll parallax runs even when the user has requested reduced motion.
findings.fix: Check matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and skip attaching the parallax listener when it matches.

findings.summary: The cards transition the layout properties top and width, and set will-change on top and width, which forces layout and paint on every frame.
findings.fix: Animate transform: translateY() for the hover lift, and limit will-change to transform (or drop it).

findings.summary: The scroll handler calls getBoundingClientRect and then writes width for each of the 24 cards in turn, causing layout thrashing on every scroll event.
findings.fix: Replace the per-scroll measurement with an IntersectionObserver, and if a visual change is still needed, apply it with transform instead of width.

findings.summary: The 'Learn more' links stay at opacity 0 when they receive keyboard focus, so focus lands on an invisible link.
findings.fix: Also reveal .more on .card:focus-within and on .more:focus-visible.

findings.summary: The 'Learn more' links appear only on hover, so touch users never see them.
findings.fix: Show .more by default and wrap the hover reveal in @media (hover: hover).

findings.summary: button:focus { outline: none } removes the focus indicator from every button.
findings.fix: Delete this rule, or replace it with a visible :focus-visible outline.

findings.summary: Opening the modal doesn't move focus into it or trap focus, Escape doesn't close it, and focus isn't returned to the trigger on close.
findings.fix: Use <dialog> with showModal(), or focus the first field on open, handle Escape, trap Tab, and restore focus to #open on close.

findings.summary: If the modal is reopened during the 350ms close, the pending timeout still removes .open and hides the dialog the user just opened.
findings.fix: Store the open and close timeout IDs and clear them at the start of the opposite action, or hide the backdrop on transitionend after checking the current state.

findings.summary: The dialog's scale and opacity transition has no reduced-motion branch.
findings.fix: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, drop the scale and keep only a brief opacity change or none.

findings.summary: The counter's requestAnimationFrame loop never stops and is never cancelled on unmount, so each remount stacks another loop that keeps writing to a detached node.
findings.fix: Keep the rAF ID, stop the loop when it reaches its target, and call cancelAnimationFrame when the tab switches away.

findings.summary: A new IntersectionObserver is created on every mount and never disconnected, so it keeps references to removed elements.
findings.fix: Unobserve elements once they are revealed, and call io.disconnect() when the stats panel unmounts.

findings.summary: Every mount adds another window resize listener and never removes it, so listeners pile up across tab switches.
findings.fix: Use a named handler or an AbortController signal, and remove it on unmount (or use a CSS media query instead).

findings.summary: The counter keeps ticking every frame even when the user has requested reduced motion.
findings.fix: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches, render the final value without animating.

findings.summary: touch-action: none on html and body turns off native touch scrolling and zoom for the whole page.
findings.fix: Remove touch-action from html and body; if needed, put touch-action: pan-y on the carousel track only.

findings.summary: The navigation controls appear only on hover, so touch users can't see them.
findings.fix: Show the controls by default and gate the hover fade behind @media (hover: hover).

findings.summary: The navigation dots are click-only divs that can't receive focus or be activated from the keyboard.
findings.fix: Make the dots <button> elements with aria-labels and visible focus styles, and show the controls on :focus-within.

findings.summary: The carousel auto-advances every 3s with no pause control and ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
findings.fix: Don't autoplay under reduced motion, add a pause button, and pause on hover and focus.

findings.summary: The autoplay interval isn't reset after a dot click or swipe, so the slide can change again right after the user picks one.
findings.fix: Keep the interval ID and clear and restart it (or pause autoplay) whenever the user navigates manually.

findings.summary: The track's slide transition has no reduced-motion alternative.
findings.fix: Set transition: none (or a crossfade) for .track under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
